RAM (Random Access Memory) and a hard drive are two different types of storage devices used in computers.

It allows for quick access to information as it is needed, but once the computer is turned off or restarted, all the data stored in RAM will be lost. RAM is typically faster than a hard drive because it has no moving parts and operates at much higher speeds.
